Extend Activity
Extend: (20-30 Minutes)
Students will complete the soil lab. Instructor will take students outside to an area where there is visible soft soil. Students will be able to fill their bag ⅓ of the way up. Students will use their spoons to act like shovels. Once collection of soil is over, bring the students back inside and instruct them to lay their bags flat on the desk. The soil should take up all of the space in their bag and the student can have a better look at their soil and answer the questions on their Let’s Find Out About Soil handout.

To dispose of soil you can take students to empty them together at once or have a bucket where students can dispose of it and then take it outside back in the environment at the conclusion of this lesson.

Reference Worksheet:
Let’s Find Out About Soil

Materials Needed:
Ziploc Sandwich bags
Plastic Spoon
